## 8. Models

<!-- models:start (generated by tools/process_models.mjs; edit outside these markers) -->

- **Bokeh** (`lumenary:bokeh`, models this process): Out of focus, every point of light in a scene turns into a small image of the lens opening, and the blur that results is called bokeh. Bright points make bright discs, and the shape of the aperture decides whether they are round, hexagonal or even heart shaped… Model: `processes/models/lumenary/bokeh.json`; theory: `treatments/lumenary/theory/08-optical.md`.
